Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_RemoteReadOnl: When enabled players can open the Economy Center anywhere via hotkey or floating button, but only to browse (catalog, wallet, receipts); every trade, listing and claim still requires standing next to a registered terminal. When disabled the window only opens at a terminal.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_CheckinAmount: Fixed amount paid by one check-in claim. How many claims an account gets per reward day is set by Check-in claims per day. Reward days follow the server real-world clock, not the in-game date. 0 turns the daily check-in off entirely (0 is off, not free): the panel shows it as unclaimable and no zero-value entry is ever posted. Survival milestones have their own amounts and keep running.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_CheckinMinPla: Check-in first claim: minimum connected time (minutes)

Minutes connected to the server today before the first check-in of the day can be claimed; every further claim uses the check-in interval instead. Connected time is real time spent online on this server: it does not accrue while offline, continues on the next login of the same day, and is not reset by death or a new character. Independent of the in-game time multiplier. 0 allows the first claim right after login.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_CheckinServer: Total check-in amount the whole server can pay out per reward day. 0 means unlimited (default). When the cap is reached the claim is refused without being consumed and is not paid retroactively. Worth revisiting when more than one claim per day is allowed.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_RewardDayRese: Daily check-in and daily caps reset at this hour in that timezone (default 0 = midnight). The timezone comes from "Reward day timezone" below, independent of the host machine timezone.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_RewardTimezon: Players' timezone as a UTC offset in hours: Taiwan 8 (default), Japan 9, India 5.5, UTC 0, US Eastern -5. Only places the reward day boundary; independent of the host machine timezone.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_AdminAdjustMa: Maximum amount of one balance adjustment, separately per currency. Native role managers may change this in Economy Administration; daily limits, reasons and audit records still apply.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_AdminAdjustDa: Per admin per reward day: separate totals for credits and debits, without offsetting. Native role managers may change this in Economy Administration.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_AdminAdjustSe: All admins combined per reward day: separate totals for credits and debits. Native role managers may change this in Economy Administration.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_AdminRoles_to: Server roles allowed to adjust balances, change currencies and register terminals. Use case-sensitive names separated by semicolons here, or select native roles in Economy Administration. The server checks every operation.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_ReadOnlyRoles: Roles allowed to view balances, receipts, audit and dashboard, but not act. Use case-sensitive names separated by semicolons here, or select native roles in Economy Administration.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_AdminSelfAdju: Roles allowed to adjust their own balance

None by default. Selected roles must also have economy write access to adjust their own balance for testing or events. Transaction and daily limits, reasons, wallet revisions and audit still apply; freezing yourself remains forbidden. Separate names with semicolons here, or preferably select roles in Economy Administration.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_CatRatePoints: Cat Coin deposit rate (points per coin)

How many Discord points become one Cat Coin when depositing (default 1 = 1:1). Boot default only: admins can change it any time in the admin panel; the rate version increments and is synced to the Discord side, new orders use the new rate.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_CatPerOrderMi: Smallest number of Cat Coins a single Discord deposit order may yield. Boot default; adjustable in the admin panel.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_CatPerOrderMa: Largest number of Cat Coins a single Discord deposit order may yield. Boot default; adjustable in the admin panel.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_CatPerAccount: Cat Coin daily deposit cap per account
Total Cat Coins one game account may deposit per reward day; orders above it are refused and the points refunded. Boot default; adjustable in the admin panel.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_CatServerDail: Total Cat Coins the whole server may deposit per reward day. Boot default; adjustable in the admin panel.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_MilestoneDays: Semicolon-separated in-game survival days (e.g. 1;3;7;14;30). Rewards use the recorded survival of a single life within this season, once per account per milestone. Death does not repeat rewards. A new season starts from zero without carrying over earlier days.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_MilestoneAmou: Semicolon-separated amounts matching the milestone days one by one (e.g. 100;150;250;400;1000). If the lists differ in length only the shared entries are used.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_SeasonDays_to: Real-world days from the current season's start. Changes update its deadline for every player immediately; 0 means manual rotation. Downtime counts. A shorter length that has already elapsed is refused: choose more days or explicitly start the next season. Only native role managers may change this.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_BalanceMax_to: Any credit that would push a player's available balance of one currency above this value is refused. It stops runaway minting from bugs or exploits; existing balances and debits are unaffected. Default for every currency; the admin panel can override it per currency.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_MarketListing: Percentage of the asking price charged when an item is listed, rounded up, at least 1 coin; burned. 0 = free listings.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_MarketSalesTa: Percentage of the sale price taken from the seller on a sale, rounded up; burned.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_MarketListing: Unsold listings are returned to the seller mailbox after this many days (the fee is not refunded).
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_MarketMaxList: How many listings one player may have on the market at the same time.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_MailboxPerAcc: How many slots one player may occupy: each unclaimed mailbox entry and each active market listing takes one; when full the player cannot buy or list, returns to the mailbox are never blocked.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_RadioInterval: How often, in real minutes, trade terminals broadcast a market summary (listing count, sellers, newest listings); 0 turns the radio off. ATMs never broadcast.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_RadioFrequenc: Radios must be tuned here to receive it, e.g. 101100 = 101.1 MHz.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_RadioRange_to: Radios within this many tiles of a trade terminal receive the broadcast; 0 = the whole map.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_RadioLanguage: auto = the server language; or one of CH / CN / EN / JP. Item names still follow the server language.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_AuctionMinHou: The shortest duration (real hours) a seller may pick when creating an auction.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_AuctionMaxHou: The longest duration (real hours) a seller may pick when creating an auction.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_AuctionMaxPer: How many auctions one player may run at the same time (market listings have their own cap).
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_AuctionMinInc: A new bid must beat the current high bid by at least this percentage (minimum 1 coin).
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_ShopBuybackEn: When on, players can sell items the catalog marks for buyback to the server at a terminal for newly minted coins. Turning it off stops buyback at once; balances are untouched. Off by default; watch mint and burn on the dashboard before opening it
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_ShopBuybackPe: Buyback per account per day (Survivor Coin)

Most Survivor Coin one account can receive from buyback per reward day (gross mint; burns do not reopen it). A sale beyond it is refused whole. 0 means this currency buys nothing back at all (0 is off, never unlimited). Default 500
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_ShopBuybackSe: Most Survivor Coin the whole server mints through buyback per reward day (burns do not reopen it). A sale beyond it is refused whole. 0 means this currency buys nothing back at all (0 is off, never unlimited). Default 20000
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_CheckinDailyL: How many check-ins one account can claim per reward day, each paying the fixed amount above. Default 1 (once a day). With 2 or more, the first claim still uses the minimum connected time and every further claim needs another check-in interval of connected time. Raising it never pays missed claims retroactively; lowering it never takes back coins already paid.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_CheckinInterv: Only in effect with more than one claim per day: minutes of connected time needed after a claim before the next one. The interval starts at the moment the previous claim was actually taken, so waiting longer does not bank up extra claims. Offline time does not count and a new reward day starts over. Default 60.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_LeaderboardEn: Shows a public board in the player panel: ranked by total holdings (available plus reserved) per currency, offline players included, system accounts excluded. While off the server refuses leaderboard requests outright. On by default.
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_LeaderboardSh: When on, the board shows the actual amount held by every listed player; when off it shows rank and account name only, while each player still sees their own amount and rank. The board never shows online status, frozen status or the available / reserved split. Off by default (conservative).
Sandbox_MinidoracatEconomy_ShopCatBuybac: Buyback per account per day (Cat Coin)

Most Cat Coin one account can receive from buyback per reward day (gross mint; burns do not reopen it). A sale beyond it is refused whole. Default 0, which stops Cat Coin buyback entirely (0 is off, never unlimited); both this and the server-wide cap must be above 0 to open it.

Most Cat Coin the whole server mints through buyback per reward day (burns do not reopen it). A sale beyond it is refused whole. Default 0, which stops Cat Coin buyback entirely (0 is off, never unlimited).
